# opnsense_ids_policy (Resource)

Policies that change the action of installed Suricata rules in bulk (**Services ▸ Intrusion Detection ▸ Policy**). Changes are applied with a rule reload.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_ids_policy" "drop_sslbl" {
  description = "drop abuse.ch matches"
  rulesets    = [opnsense_ids_ruleset.sslbl.uuid]
  new_action  = "drop"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `action` (Set of String) Only match rules whose default action is one of these: `disable`, `alert`, `drop`. Empty matches all. Defaults to `[]`.
- `content` (Set of String) Rule metadata to match, as `property.value`, e.g. `["signature_severity.Major"]`. Values must exist in the installed rules. Defaults to `[]`.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `new_action` (String) Action given to matching rules: `default`, `alert`, `drop` or `disable`. Defaults to `alert`.
- `priority` (Number) Priority, higher values are applied later and win. Defaults to `0`.
- `rulesets` (Set of String) UUIDs of the enabled rulesets this policy applies to, e.g. `[opnsense_ids_ruleset.x.uuid]`. Empty applies to all. Defaults to `[]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the IDS policy.
